description: Get term-life quotes using explicit user-provided rating inputs. Results include consumer product details, benefit comparisons, and quote-based application guidance. Each result includes an opaque quote_id valid for 30 minutes. After the user selects a quote and requests an application, call create_life_eapp to get their application link. Never invent missing inputs or an underwriting class.

gender.description: Carrier rating input, supplied by the user

health.description: User-supplied assumed health value. Read product-specific labels from get_life_quote_requirements; never infer eligibility.

mode.description: Payments per year: annual, semiannual, quarterly, monthly

frequency.description: Uses per year: 2 less than monthly, 12 monthly, 52 weekly, 365 daily

name: quote_term_life
